item.title: Perla Montemayor
item.description: I am a 34-year-old mom, Health Coach, and Personal Trainer. I share my fitness daily as an excuse to empower women. Through exercise, my purpose is to show them their inner strength. Entrepreneur and Motivator, Weather Conductor with 10 years of experience uninterrupted on air. Time management for the States of California, Texas, Nevada, and Florida within the local newscasts of Univision. Nationwide “Fill-in Anchor” of the Tempo status for Despierta America. Latin Grammys special coverage, 2018

item.title: Gloria Light
item.description: Originally from Guatemala City, Gloria began her journey in radio in 1995 in Houston, TX. From 2006 to 2012, she was a prominent voice on Digital 101.5 FM, where she connected with her audience through her energy and authenticity. In 2024, she made her highly anticipated return to Digital 101.5, now as the host of Café Retro, a show where she shares her love for classic hits and engages listeners with her charismatic presence. item.title: Christian Mata
item.description: Christian Mata Born in Monterrey, Mexico. Christian got his bachelor’s in communications from ICAHM in Monterrey. He began his radio career at a young age while living on the Mexican border. Soon after, he joined Televisa Monterrey in the sports and entertainment division. In addition to his media expertise, Christian has earned various other certifications in radio, television, photography, and advertising, and has participated in film projects as well as being the official voice for profession
